item.title: Marvel vs. Capcom and Mortal Kombat are the two games I feel are most missed by the Fighting Game Community right now
item.description: <p>I was asked about the most missed titles in the Fighting Game Community on the <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w01iP6-BZTQ">StayMAD Podcast</a>, and I wanted to write about it here as well.</p> <p>I feel that Marvel vs. Capcom and Mortal Kombat are the two games that are most missed by the Fighting Game Community right now, as they would do the most for the collective scene if these franchises received new entries that were well received by gamers.</p>

item.title: 2XKO Version 1.1.3 patch notes released
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2xko/">2XKO</a> is now entering its second full month after exiting early access, and the 2v2 fighting game is about to get a big update that should change up the characters and what's available quite a bit.</p> <p>Riot Games has now released the official Version 1.1.3 patch notes for 2XKO, which will be arriving soon for all players.</p>

item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/marvel-tokon/">Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls</a> is looking to make a big splash on the Fighting Game Community later this year though we still only know around half of the roster of heroes and villains so far.</p> <p>That may have changed now with a few more characters potentially leaking early for the 4v4 Marvel fighting game.</p>
